script.say: This is Edmonton in 1975. Every dark speck is land covered by buildings.
Edmonton didn't really grow up. It grew out.
And it sped up: more was built after 2000 than in the twenty-five years before.
Eighty-four square kilometres of buildings in 1975. A hundred and sixty-six in 2020. Nearly double.
Every big city's in the free explorer. Link's below. Yes, even Saskatoon.
